notes.title: The "5 months later" Update
notes.content:
Changelog is quite simple:
- Added image preview offset to the left while completing a puzzle.
- Fixed bug where the game would white screen if a player clicked on the "Change Background" button too fast.

- Also 3 months ago, I have finally given names to all the puzzles. Every puzzle leaderboard is now visible in the community. Compare your completion times with other players, and friends on Steam!

This will probably be the final update, unless DLC is decided on, or some game-breaking bug implies me to patch the game again.

This was a wonderful first and free experiment to understand how to push a game to Steam, and adopt some features within Steam. Shinogame hopes you look forward to our next (and more serious) project(s).

notes.title: Quality of Life Update 1
notes.content:
I have submitted another update to Tile_Perfect. This will now be considered "Version 1.0". The changelog is as follows:
[list]
[*] Added a little visible debug text to troubleshoot anyone with the main menu glitch.
[*] Added keyboard shortcut to force deletion of player progress.
[*] Game will now remember what background was selected before closing the game.
[*] Game will now indicate what version of the game is running in the main menu (currently 1.0).
[*] Better Gamepad support. It is no longer possible to navigate to the "Back" button within a puzzle while on controller. You can leave a puzzle by pressing "B".

[*] Removed a couple of debug codes I accidentally left in earlier builds.
[/list]

This update will reset any personal progress in puzzles, however this will not clear any leaderboard times you have made.

If anyone is stuck on the main menu, please send a screenshot of what results you get now.
Also please note, this game is graphically coded to support only OpenGL Core and Vulkan. If your computer's graphics cannot support either of these, it will not launch properly.

notes.title: Public release: "TILE PERFECT"
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone. This is the beginning for a lot of things. Most importantly: The establishment of "Shinogame" as a developer and publisher, and The first project for me and a couple of friends that finally sees the light of day.[/b]

This game was developed by 4 friends:

[list]
[*] Art crearted by [url=https://twitter.com/cynine]@cynine[/url]

[*] Music by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/EEPAHOY]EEPAHOY[/url]

[*] Programming by  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Bob_Barkerson/]Bob_Barkerson[/url]

[*] The guy who came up with the idea, but then ran away: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Touhini/]Touhni[/url]  
[/list]

The expected retail price for this game will be under $5 at launch, and the game is expected to launch sometime this year.

We look forward to the many challenges and experiences gathered by this simple puzzle game, and look forward to releasing more serious projects in the future.
